sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Genichiro Ashina (葦名弦一郎, Ashina Genichiro), also known as The Commander is a character and mandatory boss in which the player is meant to lose.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.text: Adopted by the Ashina after the death of his peasant mother, Genichiro is the current leader of the Ashina Clan. Concerned that his army's strength won’t be enough to withstand the impending invasion by the Interior Ministry, Genichiro seeks to abduct Kuro and obtain the Divine Heir's gift of immortality. He plans to use this power to save both his beloved country and his clan.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text:
First Encounter, Cutscene | Genichiro Ashina: The Divine Heir... Last we stood together was your uncle's funeral.
Kuro: Lord Genichiro... I- Thank you.
Wolf: Leave this to me..
Genichiro Ashina: So the noble shinobi stands in our way...
Beginning of the fight | You face...Genichiro Ashina...
After the first Deathblow | I...will not be defeated...I cannot!
After the second Deathblow | Bastard...
After cutting off Sekiro's arm (defeating Sekiro) | Is this all a shinobi has to offer?
After cutting off Sekiro's arm (having been defeated by Sekiro) | A shinobi should know the difference between honour and victory.
Walking Away | The Divine Heir is coming with me.

sections.heading: Sekiro Side Story: Hanbei the Undying Chapter 7
sections.text: One day, Kodou Takamine is summoned to the Ashina Castle to help out Doujun with his experiments. On his way up the stairs, he sees Genichiro coming down and feels he could easily take him down. However Kodou gets surprised how quickly Genichiro got close and wonders if he sensed his bloodlust. Genichiro recognizes that Kodou is from Takamine clan, and tells him that he is in his care.

sections.heading: Phases
sections.text: This boss fight has 2 phases: Phase 1, Phase 2.
